target.title: fix(discord): split encoded video URLs from captions
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes a Discord outbound send edge case where a caption + video URL can miss the existing caption-first/media-second split when the URL encodes the extension dot, such as `render%2Emp4`.

The split decision depends on Discord's local video URL classification. `new URL(...).pathname` preserves `%2E`, so a path like `/attachments/1/render%2Emp4` did not match the existing `.mp4` / `.webm` / `.mov` suffix check and was treated as non-video.

## Why This Change Was Made

The production change is intentionally small and stays inside Discord's local media detector:

```diff
 const parsed = new URL(trimmed);
-return normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(parsed.pathname);
+try {
+  return normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(decodeURIComponent(parsed.pathname));
+} catch {
+  return normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(parsed.pathname);
+}
```

This decodes URL pathnames before video-extension matching, while preserving the previous fallback for malformed percent encoding. Local non-URL paths still use the existing query/hash stripping path, and the original `mediaUrl` is still passed through to the Discord send call.

## User Impact

Discord outbound sends with a caption and an encoded video extension now follow the same behavior covered by the existing video split path: the caption text is sent first, then the video media is sent separately.

For example, `https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1/render%2Emp4?ex=1` now classifies like a normal `.mp4` URL for the Discord caption/video split decision.

## Evidence

Local validation:

- `git diff --check` passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/discord/src/outbound-adapter.test.ts` passed with 1 test file and 48 tests.

Focused behavior covered by the test:

```text
mediaUrl = https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1/render%2Emp4?ex=1
caption send -> sendMessageDiscord(..., "rendered clip", ...)
media send   -> sendMessageDiscord(..., "", { mediaUrl })
```

Call chain / impact:

```text
discordOutbound captioned media send
-> normalizeMediaPathForExtension(mediaUrl)
-> URL pathname extraction
-> video extension check
-> caption/media split decision
```

Scope and sibling surfaces:

- Production diff is limited to `extensions/discord/src/media-detection.ts` and changes only URL pathname normalization before suffix detection.
- The test change extends the existing Discord outbound split test in `extensions/discord/src/outbound-adapter.test.ts` instead of adding a new broad test surface.
- No shared media-core helper is changed; this PR intentionally scopes the fix to Discord's local caption/video split detector.
- Malformed percent encoding still falls back to the original URL pathname, so this does not add a new send-time exception path.
